_meta.note: Dated price snapshot for BOM costing (unit = pack_usd / pack_qty). Every price was read from the linked page with WebFetch on the check date; prices exclude shipping and sales tax unless stated. Store pages change often, so re-check before ordering. Amazon blocked automated reading, so no Amazon prices are used.

servos.MG996R.note: Towerpro MG996R Servo 25T 11kg / 0.16sec / 55g (genuine TowerPro brand). $6.99 special price, regular $12.49; page says In Stock and ships from USA or Global warehouse.

servos.DS3218.note: eBay US listing 'DSservo DS3218 MG 20kg Metal Gear Digital Steering Servo For RC Baja Car Robot', brand DSSERVO, 1 servo, US $16.95 or Best Offer. The vendor page (rcdrone.top) was sold out.

servos.DS3225.note: eBay US listing '25KG DS3225 MG 180° Metal Steering Digital Waterproof Servo High Torque RC Hobby', brand DSSERVO, 1 servo + 25T aluminium arm. US $12.00 item price (was $15.00); shipping US $5.50 not included.
